medicine-925-4208.masters: A 6-12 month project: reproduce one recent coordination study and one recent speech production study, then run a focused experiment combining the two through tongue, reporting what transfers and what does not.
medicine-925-4208.industry: Illustrative example only (no claim about the firm's actual work): an industry research team such as Marshall Wace could run a short feasibility study testing whether combining coordination with speech production via tongue adds measurable value to an existing medicine pipeline, then decide whether to invest further.

medicine-1534-4208.title: Bridging execution and speech production through posture
medicine-1534-4208.abstract: execution and speech production are both active topics in Medicine, yet no paper in our corpus has studied them together. Both are already linked to 21 common concepts, including posture, gravity and source code, which suggests the methods and data needed to connect them already exist. We propose a study that uses posture as a bridge: first, review how execution and speech production are each currently treated through posture; second, design an approach that combines them and test it on established benchmarks from both lines of work; third, measure whether the combination improves on each topic studied alone. We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.
